sources.title: Quran-Lab/zipformer_p-arabic-v3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: zipformer_p-arabic-v3 A 65.5M-parameter streaming phoneme recogniser for Qur'an recitation (Hafs 'an 'Asim), built on Zipformer2 with a CTC head. It transcribes recitation directly into a 251-symbol Qur'anic phonetic alphabet that encodes tajweed-relevant distinctions: madd length, gemination, ghunna, ikhfaa, qalqalah, and the emphatic consonants.
